Bill.BriefDescription: Allocating the cost of archives and records management services for institutions of higher education based on actual services and service hours.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting institutions of higher education thatdo not use archives and records management services from payment forthose services; and amending RCW 40.14.025.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 40.14.025 and 2003 c 163 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The secretary of state and the director of financial managementshall jointly establish a procedure and formula for allocating thecosts of services provided by the division of archives and recordsmanagement to state agencies. Beginning January 31, 2012, forinstitutions of higher education as defined in RCW 28B.10.016, theprocedure and formula for allocating the costs of services providedshall be based on actual services and service hours rendered to eachinstitution of higher education. The total amount allotted forservices to state agencies shall not exceed the appropriation to thearchives and records management account during any allotment period. (2) There is created the archives and records management account inthe state treasury which shall consist of all fees and chargescollected under this section. The account shall be appropriated p. 1 SSB 5517exclusively for the payment of costs and expenses incurred in theoperation of the division of archives and records management asspecified by law.
